description: Run a JavaScript (ECMAScript) regular expression against text and return every match with its index and capture groups. Use it to verify a pattern actually matches what you intend before putting it in code. Reports a syntax error if the pattern does not compile.

flags.description: Regex flags, any of d g i m s u v y. Without "g" only the first match is returned.

pattern.description: The regex source, without surrounding slashes.

name: regex_test
title: Test a regular expression
